heading.en: Why check, and can checking fail?

hook.en: A bakery that never checks its oven temperature will burn bread one day. But even the best checks cannot stop a sudden rise in the price of wheat.
hook.kn: ಓವನ್ ತಾಪಮಾನ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸದ ಬೇಕರಿ ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಬ್ರೆಡ್ ಸುಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮಾಡಿದರೂ ಗೋಧಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲಾಗದು.

objectives.en: Explain six points of importance of controlling

narration.en: A bakery that never checks its oven temperature will burn bread one day. But even the best checks cannot stop a sudden rise in the price of wheat.
narration.kn: ಓವನ್ ತಾಪಮಾನ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸದ ಬೇಕರಿ ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಬ್ರೆಡ್ ಸುಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮಾಡಿದರೂ ಗೋಧಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲಾಗದು.

body.en: Controlling helps in accomplishing organisational goals, judging the accuracy of standards, making efficient use of resources, improving employee motivation, ensuring order and discipline, and facilitating coordination in action.
body.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆ, ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳ ನಿಖರತೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಸಮರ್ಥ ಬಳಕೆ, ನೌಕರರ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ, ಶಿಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮನ್ವಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Controlling helps in accomplishing organisational goals, judging the accuracy of standards, making efficient use of resources, improving employee motivation, ensuring order and discipline, and facilitating coordination in action.
narration.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆ, ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳ ನಿಖರತೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಸಮರ್ಥ ಬಳಕೆ, ನೌಕರರ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ, ಶಿಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮನ್ವಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: It is difficult to set quantitative standards for things like job satisfaction or employee morale. A firm has little control over external factors such as government policy, technology changes or competition. Employees often resist control, for example CCTV cameras. And control is costly in time, effort and money, so its benefits must exceed its cost.
body.kn: ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಾನದಂಡ ನಿಗದಿ ಕಷ್ಟ; ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ನೌಕರರ ವಿರೋಧ; ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ವೆಚ್ಚದಾಯಕ.

problem.en: A small shop with sales of ₹3 lakh a year is advised to install an inventory-tracking system costing ₹2 lakh a year. Should it, and which limitation applies?

steps.en: The control system would cost two-thirds of the shop's entire annual sales.
Control is worth it only when its benefits exceed its cost.
Here the cost is far too high for a small firm.

answer.en: No; controlling is a costly affair, and small firms may not afford elaborate systems.

points.en: Controlling helps achieve goals and use resources efficiently.
